statements.text: balanceOf is initialized as an empty mapping, so the sum of balances is 0.
The first depositor deposits 1,000 assets into HypoVault.
Share calculation (1,000 × 1,000,000) / 1 uses the pre-set totalSupply of 1,000,000, yielding 1,000,000,000 shares for the first deposit.
The first depositor receives 1,000,000,000 shares for 1,000 assets.
After the deposit, sum of balances is 1,000,000,000 while totalSupply is 1,001,000,000, so the ERC-20 invariant sum of balances equals totalSupply is broken.
The first depositor gets 1000x more shares than a fair mint would give.
